**Syntax supported:** `*` (any run of characters), `?` (single character), and a trailing `/`, which is stripped before matching (src/filter.zig:49, 52-54). The matcher's loop treats only `?`, `*`, and literal equality specially (src/filter.zig:61, 64).

**Is `[abc]` a character class?** No. In the code shown, `[` is compared as an ordinary literal character, so `[abc]` would match only the literal text `[abc]` (src/filter.zig:61). Nothing handles brackets.

**Caveats:**
- The context shows `matchPattern` being used for excluded and included patterns (src/filter.zig:285-286, 306-309). It doesn't show the CLI parsing of `--exclude`/`--include`, so I can't confirm that every such flag goes through this function. `--include` extensions use `matchesExt`, which isn't shown (src/filter.zig:297-298).
- Tests cover only `*`, `?`, and trailing `/` (src/filter.zig:322-327). None covers brackets.
